_doc: Steffie — a Pueblo Store Lead: average height, a little heavier set, Hispanic, with better social polish than Amandy and a deeply two-faced core. Sweet and warm to your face, carving you up in meetings the second the door closes; your plans come back wearing her name. Dialogue-only.
name: Steffie
title: Store Lead, Pueblo
samplePhrase: I'm in your corner, Todd. Always have been.
